{# Open Graph and Twitter card tags. Material ships none of these, so every link to this site - 2,034 pages of it - previewed in Slack, X, LinkedIn and iMessage as a bare URL with no title, no description and no image. mkdocs-material has a `social` plugin that renders a per-page card, but it pulls in Cairo and Pillow as build dependencies and needs system libraries installed on the runner; static tags against one committed card image get most of the benefit for none of that, and cannot break the build. The image is assets/brand/social-preview-1280x640.png, generated by assets/brand/social-preview.html (one template shared by all four Zero to Hero sites) and the same file uploaded to GitHub's own social preview, so the repo and the site present identically. NOTE: like partials/nav-item.html, this couples the site to Material's template structure - it extends base.html and fills its `extrahead` block. After a mkdocs-material bump, confirm that block still exists.
